items.claim: Lodging is reimbursed up to 220 dollars per night.
Hotel stays are paid at actual cost with a nightly ceiling of 220 dollars.
A stay above the lodging cap needs written approval before the trip.
Lodging above the cap can be approved after the trip.
Lodging is reimbursed up to 250 dollars per night.
The meal limit is 95 dollars per day in high-cost cities.
Alcohol is reimbursable with a receipt.
Receipts are needed for a single meal over 25 dollars.
Economy class is required for flights under six hours.
Business class is allowed for flights of six hours or more.
Flights must be booked 14 days ahead unless a business reason is recorded.
A trip costing more than 2,500 dollars needs approval before booking.
An advance may be up to 60 percent of the approved estimate.
An advance may not exceed 80 percent of the approved estimate.
Expense reports are due within 30 days after the trip ends.
Reports must be filed within one month of returning.
Reports filed after 60 days are reimbursed automatically.
An unliquidated advance older than 45 days is taken out of payroll.
